```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(partitions)
library(entropies)
```

# Partitions

The list of partitions obtained with `parts`:

```{r}
n <- 10
pn <- parts(n)
#To obtain the intparts with strictly some number of bins we have
p10in3atmost <- restrictedparts(10,3)
p10in3 <- restrictedparts(10,3,include.zero=FALSE)
```

Conjugates are the "transposes of Ferrers diagrams"

```{r conjugates}
conjugate(pn)
```

The primitive `setparts`returns a set partition on the conventional set of `n`elements that has that integer partition.
```{r}
setparts(pn[,2])
```

# Entropy exploration

The dominance order between partitions is also reflected by their entropies. This is probably a property of axiomatically defined entropy. 

```{r}
pnH <- apply(pn,2,entropy::entropy)
p10in3H <- apply(p10in3, 2, entropy::entropy)
p10in3H
```

## Auxiliary function

A function that transforms an integer partition in its standard formula with the non-zero parts separated by plus signs.

```{r}
toFormula <- function(p){
    stringr::str_c(p[p!=0], collapse="+")
}
apply(pn,2,toFormula)
partLength <- function(p){length(p[p!=0])}
# A parsing function
fromFormula <- function(sp,n=0){
    intlist <- as.integer(
        str_split(sp,pattern="\\+", simplify=TRUE))
    #n <- max(n,length(intlist))
    mat <- matrix(
        data = 0, 
        nrow=1,
        ncol=max(n,length(intlist)))
    mat[1:length(intlist)] <-  intlist
    return(as.partition(mat))
}
# The dominance order
dom <- function(p1,p2){
    all(cumsum(p1) >= cumsum(p2))
}
```


# Exploration of partitions

# Obtaining info from partitions
With the partition list previously studied, record a dataframe of partitions 

```{r}
n <- 10
pn <- parts(n)
partsN <- data.frame(
    name = apply(pn,2,toFormula),
    length = apply(pn,2,partLength),
    H = apply(pn,2,entropy::entropy),
    partition = apply(t(as.matrix(pn)),2, as.partition)
)
partsN 
```

## Creating concept lattices of partitions

```{r fca analysis}
#install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("Rgraphviz")
library(Rgraphviz)
library(hasseDiagram)
library(fcaR)
n <- 8
pn <- parts(n)
numpn <- ncol(pn)
I <- matrix(data=FALSE, nrow=numpn, ncol=numpn)
for(i in 1:numpn){
    for (j in 1:numpn){
        I[i,j] <- dom(pn[,i],pn[,j])#Actually transpose!
    }
}
objectNames <- apply(pn, 2, toFormula)
attributeNames <- objectNames
colnames(I) <- attributeNames
rownames(I) <- objectNames
k <- FormalContext$new(I)
k$reduce()
k$find_concepts()
k$concepts$plot()
```
# Aggregating all 

Generating the data:

```{r}
nparts <- data.frame()
for (n in 1:10){
    pn <- parts(n)
    nparts <- rbind(
        nparts,
        data.frame(
            n,#count to be distributed
            name = apply(pn,2,toFormula),
            length = apply(pn,2,partLength),
            H = apply(pn,2,entropy::entropy)#,
            # partition = apply(t(as.matrix(pn)),
            #                   2, as.partition)
            )
        )
}
```
